entities.name: UniProt Q0JNI9
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Oryza sativa subsp. japonica PHYTOCHROME INTERACTING FACTOR-LIKE 15.

Annotated as a nuclear transcription factor and possible negative regulator of phyB-dependent light signaling; associated GO terms include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, protein dimerization, and regulation of transcription.
Sequence length 637 aa; calculated molecular weight 66,588.69 Da; theoretical pI 6.082; GRAVY −0.4749.
Pfam detects an HLH domain (PF00010.32) at residues 388–434.
